It draws on content delivery network (CDN) log data and Opal-generated insights, letting you monitor AI traffic patterns, see which AI platforms visit most often, and identify which pages attract the most AI attention.</p><h2 id="h_01KTVKV09ZFS7BBW3G2QTW9ZAM">April 24—Beta feature<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KTVKV09ZFS7BBW3G2QTW9ZAM"></a></h2><div class="beta">Apply to join the <strong>Markdown for Agents for CMS 12 and CMS 13</strong> beta on the <a href="https://www.optimizely.com/beta/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Optimizely beta signup page</a>.</div><ul><li data-list-item-id="edcf0cf04c7dc5d210b7f054a7d1bb875">

The feature does not affect the page experience for human visitors.</li></ul><h2 id="h_01KPZWGQG1CDF2VAKBSMKRSXYH">April 10—CMS major version policy<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KPZWGQG1CDF2VAKBSMKRSXYH"></a></h2><h4 id="h_01KR4K1R5NAJT4P11GF906YBAB"><span data-teams="true"><strong>Active Development</strong></span></h4><p><span data-teams="true">All new product development is focused exclusively on the latest major version of CMS. No new functionality will be built for earlier major versions. The current latest version is <strong>CMS 13</strong>.</span></p><p><span data-teams="true">Optimizely actively monitors, triages, and fixes severe bugs and security issues for the current major version and one prior major version. The currently maintained versions are CMS 13 and CMS 12.</span></p><p><span data-teams="true">As part of this policy, Optimizely does not provide ongoing bug monitoring, bug fixes, security monitoring, or patch releases for older major versions (CMS 11 and earlier), except in cases involving severe security vulnerabilities raised by customers/partners. This approach allows Optimizely to continue investing in innovation and the long-term evolution of the platform while balancing the realities of maintaining the older versions of our software.</span></p><h4 id="h_01KR4K2C9EX5662Q5DCKXX22RD"><span data-teams="true"><strong>Support Policy</strong></span></h4><p><span data-teams="true">Optimizely will continue to provide support for all major versions of CMS for existing customers. Our support teams will work with customers to investigate, triage, reproduce, and provide guidance on reported issues, including security-related concerns. While customers may continue operating older versions of CMS, resolution options may vary depending on the age of the version, underlying platform dependencies, and technical feasibility.</span></p><p><span data-teams="true">CMS 13 represents one of the most significant releases for Optimizely CMS, with major investments in AI-powered capabilities, the new Visual Builder, Embedded DAM, performance improvements, extensibility, and modern developer tooling — all designed to support the next generation of digital experiences. We STRONGLY encourage customers to upgrade to the latest version to take advantage of these advancements.</span></p><h4 id="h_01KR4K2N06Y19Z4ZXMJHE7CZZH"><span data-teams="true"><strong>End of Life</strong></span></h4><p><span data-teams="true">Optimizely does NOT enforce end-of-life through forced upgrades, disabled environments, or removal of access to older versions. Customers may continue using older major versions of CMS based on their business needs and migration timelines.</span></p><h2 id="h_01KPB9G3ZP5EJA67H3TDGVSMEF">CMS Core<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KPB9G3ZP5EJA67H3TDGVSMEF"></a></h2><p><code>EPiServer.CMS.Core</code></p><h3 id="h_01JN4AZV48WKNADH3KWC2GYDS5">May 22—12.24.0<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01JN4AZV48WKNADH3KWC2GYDS5"></a></h3><ul><li data-list-item-id="e0d9db2d5d1c10383ec40fb389c620f28">

<li data-list-item-id="e62c181332da8292ddce407a402453080">
<strong>DAM metadata consistency</strong> – Improved consistency and availability of Digital Asset Management (DAM) asset metadata within CMS, ensuring that <code>Description</code>, <code>FocalPoint</code>, and <code>Renditions</code> data for images are now uniformly accessible with both the REST API and Optimizely Graph. This provides a more unified and reliable data experience, with all relevant metadata consistently saved in the CMS database regardless of the retrieval method.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ed07a63271368c35ada62877b14feb9b2">
<strong>Cached metadata rendering</strong> – Added cached DAM asset metadata rendering support for templates. The DAM integration now reuses metadata stored in the CMS database to render assets without making extra calls to the CMP Graph API, improving page load performance. Three rendering methods are available: <ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e5a7ad8b60164c4182af72206966c9368">
<code><dam-asset></code> TagHelper (recommended)</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e102760ac747451c0a38328730639661c">
<code>RenderTagWithMetadata</code> HtmlHelper</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ecb698cb7c6ccf5524770822ac3a9d13f">
<code>IUrlHelper.DamAssetUrl</code> extension for direct URL generation with optional rendition support (new)</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e1e6d5e09232100c69c27451f20fd0406">
<strong>Asset tracking and cleanup</strong> – Enhanced DAM asset tracking and cleanup processes to ensure accurate management of deleted asset references. This improvement addresses previous limitations where rendition IDs were stored instead of asset IDs, and where public API methods for deleting or updating mapped identities were unavailable.<ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ecaf711a609a9deb346ef3d96ddceaa10">
<code>AssetID</code> <strong>storage</strong> – Implemented the storage of the primary <code>AssetID</code> within the metadata field when creating or updating mapped identities in <code>tblMappedIdentity</code>. This enables correlation of deletion webhooks (which carry the <code>AssetID</code>) with mapped identities, regardless of whether you initially selected a rendition or original asset.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e0a3fecb50b6529fa82466ffe32b20902">
<code>IDAMAssetService.DeleteByAssetId(assetId)</code> <strong>endpoint</strong> – Added REST API endpoint for deleting mapped identity entries, which lets you remove orphaned mapped identities from <code>tblMappedIdentity</code>, preventing data inconsistencies. stale data, and inaccurate asset usage tracking.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="efcb4b4a0da367236b6abca840bb09492">
<p><strong>DAM Library picker</strong> – Added the ability to select multiple assets from the Optimizely DAM Library picker in a single operation. Editors can now add multiple assets to the Content Area and Content Reference List properties without repeatedly opening the picker, reducing friction when building content-heavy pages. The picker enforces minimum and maximum item limits configured on the property and provides live feedback during selection. </p>
<p>You must also have <code>EPiServer.CMS.UI</code> 12.34.3 to access this feature.</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul><p><strong>Bug fixes</strong></p><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ef5dffc48071b1483cb1c854a6aef134d">

<li data-list-item-id="e5b2d9b115fda070108d01feb307f679c">
<a href="https://world.optimizely.com/support/bug-list/bug/CMS-49316" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">CMS-49316</a> – Fixed the issue where <code>DamAssetInfo.Renditions</code> was always <code>null</code> because renditions were not fetched when <code>assetType</code> was <code>null</code>. </ul><h2 id="h_01KP67VYAZ70CQYPFYQS5N3Y6F">Optimizely Forms <a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KP67VYAZ70CQYPFYQS5N3Y6F"></a></h2><h3 id="h_01JN4B6TAHBRSRKK0FV0GJQ31C">May 5—<code>EPiServer.Forms</code> 5.10.8<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01JN4B6TAHBRSRKK0FV0GJQ31C"></a></h3><p><strong>Bug fix</strong></p><ul><li data-list-item-id="e8918f8cbb480ad10a923f34cf2652f49">
<a href="https://world.optimizely.com/support/bug-list/bug/AFORM-4768" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">AFORM-4768</a> – Fixed the issue where sites failed to start due to a constructor conflict in <code>EPiServer.Forms</code> when using <code>StructureMap</code> for dependency injection after upgrading to <code>CMS.Graph</code> 4.3.1.</li></ul><h3 id="h_01KQSYCSTQQ88X2HW5NY0JZJ93">May 5—<code>Optimizely.Cms.Forms</code> 1.5.1<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KQSYCSTQQ88X2HW5NY0JZJ93"></a></h3><p><strong>Bug fix</strong></p><ul><li data-list-item-id="e0e3b140f0d77d5e3609a0a646de070f5">
<a href="https://world.optimizely.com/support/bug-list/bug/AFORM-4767" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">AFORM-4767</a> – Fixed the issue where images stored in the global assets folder returned a wildcard hostname instead of the primary hostname when queried through <code>FormContainer</code> in headless Forms implementations.</li></ul><h3 id="h_01KQAF6E1TTBDJPTA70DG89WNB">March 13—<code>Optimizely.Cms.Forms</code> 1.5.0<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KQAF6E1TTBDJPTA70DG89WNB"></a></h3><p><strong>Enhancement</strong></p><ul><li data-list-item-id="e7afa3db1b28826fdaf650c957015bf3c">Added smooth deployment support for Optimizely Forms with Optimizely Graph. Form data is now preserved during Optimizely Graph index rebuilds, preventing data loss and ensuring forms continue to function as expected after activating smooth deployment.</li></ul><h3 id="h_01KP678GAR58Z4DZY3MJBHN044">January 5—<code>Optimizely.Cms.Forms</code> 1.4.2<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KP678GAR58Z4DZY3MJBHN044"></a></h3><p><strong>Bug fixes</strong></p><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e5403a9b958eb70ea4f022be5f6eae0f9">
<a href="https://world.optimizely.com/support/bug-list/bug/AFORM-4730" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">AFORM-4730</a> – Fixed an issue where the delta synchronization job would fail when content was deleted, preventing users from successfully indexing content. The delta indexing job now runs as expected, ensuring content can be indexed without errors even after deletions.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e6528e4664fa64ac740fbd31b54885cc7">
<a href="https://world.optimizely.com/support/bug-list/bug/AFORM-4733" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">AFORM-4733</a> – Fixed an issue where the <code>Optimizely.Cms.Forms.ContentGraph</code> package was incorrectly attempting to index non-Form content, leading to an <code>ArgumentException</code> and indexing failures for regular content (pages, blocks, and folders). The Forms <code>ContentGraph</code> package now correctly processes only Form-related content, ensuring smooth indexing for all content types.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e15f85fcd41ac7020eb6855e7618cd704">
<a href="https://world.optimizely.com/support/bug-list/bug/AFORM-4734" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">AFORM-4734</a> – Fixed an issue where a <code>NullReferenceException</code> would occur during site initialization when <code>EPiServer.Forms</code>, <code>Optimizely.Cms.Forms.ContentGraph</code>, and <code>Optimizely.ContentGraph.Cms</code> packages were present, preventing the site from starting. Sites now initialize successfully with these packages installed.</li>
</ul><h2 id="h_01HP2J9A16G24Z9SX2JGDEJ08H">Optimizely Image Library Service<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01HP2J9A16G24Z9SX2JGDEJ08H"></a></h2><p><code>EPiServer.ImageLibrary.ImageSharp</code></p><h3 id="h_01KR48S0J8DKN3TKGAV2W9530A">May 8—2.0.6<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KR48S0J8DKN3TKGAV2W9530A"></a></h3><p><strong>Enhancement</strong></p><ul><li data-list-item-id="e85b2ad719a1475698dcc9aff4691de63">Updated the bundled <code>SixLabors.ImageSharp</code> minimum version from 3.1.7 to 3.1.11, which patches a <a href="https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-rxmq-m78w-7wmc" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">moderate-severity vulnerability</a>. See the <a href="https://docs.developers.optimizely.com/content-management-system/docs/upgrade-to-cms-core-12170" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">upgrade package reference guidance</a>.</li></ul><h2 id="h_01KR48TSNQSS7YNHNBMEQMY85Q">Optimizely Language Manager<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KR48TSNQSS7YNHNBMEQMY85Q"></a></h2><p><code>EPiServer.Labs.LanguageManager</code></p><h3 id="h_01KMN66EDH2Z5NSB04K09774KE">January 5—5.5.3<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KMN66EDH2Z5NSB04K09774KE"></a></h3><p><strong>Bug fix</strong></p><ul><li data-list-item-id="e14fe58537e5f1e4e8c4490db0c3f178d">
<a href="https://world.optimizely.com/support/bug-list/bug/LM-714" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">LM-714</a> – Fixed an issue where the Learning Management (LM) system was using an outdated version (0.21.1) of the axios package, which contained a known vulnerability. Language Manager was upgraded to use axios version 0.22.0, aligning with the version used by CMS, to eliminate this security risk.</li></ul><h2 id="dxp">Optimizely Salesforce Connector<a class="link-anchor" href="#dxp"></a></h2><p><code>EPiServer.MarketingAutomationIntegration.Salesforce.5.2.0</code></p><h3 id="h_01KSR0CF87NTJAB2SR26V52513">May 26—5.2.0<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KSR0CF87NTJAB2SR26V52513"></a></h3><p><strong>Enhancement</strong></p><ul><li data-list-item-id="ee9fdecde6e4bae3885a8c57bba06433d">Added support for Salesforce External Client Apps using the OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials flow for the <a href="https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/7841448143885-Salesforce-connector-CMS-12" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">CMS 12 Salesforce connector</a>. Customers whose Salesforce orgs do not support creating Connected Apps can now authenticate the connector using a Client ID, Client Secret, and My Domain URL. Existing Connected App configurations continue to work without changes.</li></ul><h2 id="h_01KSR0D28YK19ZDMBJ0Z3N9ZBE">DXP<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KSR0D28YK19ZDMBJ0Z3N9ZBE"></a></h2><h3 id="h_01KP67ADM64AZZ0VKREZ8SS000">April 28<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KP67ADM64AZZ0VKREZ8SS000"></a></h3><p><strong>Enhancement</strong></p><ul><li data-list-item-id="e25e7df244eef9689b6d62d974c518db3">Added support for Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR), which lets you update individual pages without rebuilding your entire site. ISR reduces build times, improves performance for large or frequently updated sites, and reduces infrastructure load. See <a href="https://docs.developers.optimizely.com/digital-experience-platform/docs/nextjs-isr-caching-and-optimizely-graph-webhooks" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Next.js ISR caching and Optimizely Graph webhooks</a>.</li></ul><h3 id="h_01KQAAW03YNWHFH83W5795Q8QD">March 30<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KQAAW03YNWHFH83W5795Q8QD"></a></h3><p><strong>Enhancements</strong></p><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ed6fa7001e0fc9f6dec194ff53b4ffca1">
<strong>Pageview metric</strong> – Updated the pageview reporting metric to align with billing dates instead of calendar dates. Pageview data in DXP now matches the Opti ID Admin Center, ensuring consistency across all reporting surfaces.<ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e209556867e5941d5b319e7a03bb5ff23">
<p><strong>How are my pageviews calculated?</strong></p>
<p>Pageview counts are aggregated from Application Insights and include traffic across all of your environments.</p>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e71f0d91ada2a3b75e3dc13c498b929c1">
<p><strong>Why do my pageview numbers look different than before?</strong></p>
<p>Optimizely transitioned from calendar-based reporting to contract-aligned reporting. This change ensures that what you see on your dashboard matches the usage data leveraged for billing.</p>
<p>Previously, data was shown from the first to the end of each month. Now, your dashboard reflects your specific billing cycle (for example, <em>March 6 – April 5</em>).</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="efb8271a1c89d44a750596b7691754a45">
<strong>Availability metric</strong> – Updated the availability metric to use a more granular calculation method. The revised calculation provides more precise reporting.<ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e335f0b078794530bc659314592bc782a">
<p><strong>How is availability calculated?</strong></p>
<p>Availability is now calculated using a high-resolution, daily-weighted average. Optimizely measures uptime down to the second every 24 hours (86,400 seconds per day) to determine your daily percentage. Your monthly availability is then derived from the average of these precise daily snapshots.</p>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ebc2bb83d73bc04294bb93e4906722683">
<p><strong>How does this new availability calculation benefit me?</strong></p>
<p>Optimizely moved to a granular, second-based calculation. This increased precision eliminates rounding discrepancies and gives you the most accurate view of your service level performance to date.</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul><h3 id="h_01KP67B1QH4XRVH3RMRPD35WAE">March 26<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KP67B1QH4XRVH3RMRPD35WAE"></a></h3><p><strong>Enhancement</strong></p><ul><li data-list-item-id="ef87aa195127d331b6d6f501048902e3d">Updated the database export user interface (UI) to improve clarity and usability. The previous <strong>Expired database file</strong> list has been replaced with a paginated view of database exports from the past 30 days, providing a more intuitive and consistent history of recent exports.</li></ul><h2 id="h_01KMN69TJ0HYVRDXR30TD8ZDX2">Optimizely Reporting<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KMN69TJ0HYVRDXR30TD8ZDX2"></a></h2><h3 id="h_01KP67BMN8GJ9G0G5KSAE8TA3T">February 3<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KP67BMN8GJ9G0G5KSAE8TA3T"></a></h3><p><strong>Enhancement</strong></p><ul><li data-list-item-id="ece893956ff6494f532150b3a12ceb2d9">
<span data-teams="true">Improved insights into the </span><a href="https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/41855081531021-GEO-Analytics-for-CMS-PaaS" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" id="menur43a8" title="https://docs.developers.optimizely.com/content-management-system/v1.0.0-cms-saas/docs/geo-insights-for-cms-saas#view-data" aria-label="Link Crawl-to-Refer Ratio"><span data-teams="true">Crawl-to-Refer Ratio</span></a><span data-teams="true"> with new comparison capabilities. You can view the crawl-to-refer ratio comparison between your selected timeframe and the prior period to understand how the ratio changes over time and your optimizations or market shifts impact it.</span>
</li></ul><h3 id="h_01KP67C25DVG5HGZB8B7NAWD1Y"><span data-teams="true">January 28</span><a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KP67C25DVG5HGZB8B7NAWD1Y"></a></h3><p><strong>Enhancement</strong></p><ul><li data-list-item-id="e5a58865da7119abc020da675bd3c9af4">
<span data-teams="true">Expanded AI platform visibility in</span><span data-teams="true"> </span><a href="https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/41855081531021-GEO-Analytics-for-CMS-PaaS" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><span data-teams="true">Crawl-to-Refer Ratio</span></a><span data-teams="true">. The dashboard now displays the top six AI platforms based on AI request volume, matching the top six entries in the AI-Agent Analysis table.</span>
</li></ul>

## April 10—CMS major version policy[](#h_01KPZWGQG1CDF2VAKBSMKRSXYH)

#### **Active Development**

All new product development is focused exclusively on the latest major version of CMS. No new functionality will be built for earlier major versions. The current latest version is **CMS 13**.

Optimizely actively monitors, triages, and fixes severe bugs and security issues for the current major version and one prior major version. The currently maintained versions are CMS 13 and CMS 12.

As part of this policy, Optimizely does not provide ongoing bug monitoring, bug fixes, security monitoring, or patch releases for older major versions (CMS 11 and earlier), except in cases involving severe security vulnerabilities raised by customers/partners. This approach allows Optimizely to continue investing in innovation and the long-term evolution of the platform while balancing the realities of maintaining the older versions of our software.

#### **Support Policy**

Optimizely will continue to provide support for all major versions of CMS for existing customers. Our support teams will work with customers to investigate, triage, reproduce, and provide guidance on reported issues, including security-related concerns. While customers may continue operating older versions of CMS, resolution options may vary depending on the age of the version, underlying platform dependencies, and technical feasibility.

CMS 13 represents one of the most significant releases for Optimizely CMS, with major investments in AI-powered capabilities, the new Visual Builder, Embedded DAM, performance improvements, extensibility, and modern developer tooling — all designed to support the next generation of digital experiences. We STRONGLY encourage customers to upgrade to the latest version to take advantage of these advancements.

#### **End of Life**

Optimizely does NOT enforce end-of-life through forced upgrades, disabled environments, or removal of access to older versions. Customers may continue using older major versions of CMS based on their business needs and migration timelines.

**Enhancements**

*   **Pageview metric** – Updated the pageview reporting metric to align with billing dates instead of calendar dates. Pageview data in DXP now matches the Opti ID Admin Center, ensuring consistency across all reporting surfaces.
    *   **How are my pageviews calculated?**
        
        Pageview counts are aggregated from Application Insights and include traffic across all of your environments.
        
    *   **Why do my pageview numbers look different than before?**
        
        Optimizely transitioned from calendar-based reporting to contract-aligned reporting. This change ensures that what you see on your dashboard matches the usage data leveraged for billing.
        
        Previously, data was shown from the first to the end of each month. Now, your dashboard reflects your specific billing cycle (for example, _March 6 – April 5_).
        
*   **Availability metric** – Updated the availability metric to use a more granular calculation method. The revised calculation provides more precise reporting.
    *   **How is availability calculated?**
        
        Availability is now calculated using a high-resolution, daily-weighted average. Optimizely measures uptime down to the second every 24 hours (86,400 seconds per day) to determine your daily percentage. Your monthly availability is then derived from the average of these precise daily snapshots.
        
    *   **How does this new availability calculation benefit me?**
        
        Optimizely moved to a granular, second-based calculation. This increased precision eliminates rounding discrepancies and gives you the most accurate view of your service level performance to date.
